manual_only.title: Enable seccomp filtering
manual_only.rationale: Seccomp reduces syscall surface and limits the effect of application-level compromise on the host kernel boundary.
actions: Set seccompProfile.type to RuntimeDefault at minimum.
Use Localhost profiles for stricter workloads if validated.
Test the runtime profile against the sandbox process tree before production rollout.
manual_only.snippet:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: REPLACE_ME
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cua
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
      - name: REPLACE_ME
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 10001
          runAsGroup: 10001
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: ["ALL"]
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault

manual_only.title: Reduce service account token exposure
manual_only.rationale: Mounted service account tokens expand blast radius when a pod is compromised and should be disabled unless the workload truly needs Kubernetes API access.
actions: Set automountServiceAccountToken: false for workloads that do not need the API.
Use a dedicated least-privilege service account when API access is required.
Keep token mounts read-only and review RBAC bindings.

actions: Remove unnecessary setuid/setgid binaries from the image.
